scope: One science-only comparison on the frozen lag3 proposal challenge; no timing, tuning, fallback, holdout, RF, or ARM claim.

methods.reference: stable packed V4 FP64, maximum=1, seeded=false
methods.candidate: strided V4 with unchanged FP32 FFTW binary, maximum=1, seeded=false

decision.positive: fractional_complete and exact_score-control_score strictly greater than 0.025
decision.reference_retention: positive candidate associated to positive reference within circular timing <=2 us and CFO <=8 kHz
decision.extra: candidate positive not associated to a positive reference
decision.identity_gate: retain all reference positives, add no positives, and change neither selected window nor rank order

constructed_truth.association: each proposal compared independently with every injected pilot within circular timing <=2 us and CFO <=8 kHz
constructed_truth.report: raw coordinate and fractional-complete coordinate matches for reference and candidate, separately from detector labels
constructed_truth.negative_semantics: noise/tone have no coordinate target; proposals are not called false alarms
constructed_truth.positive_semantics: injected pilot presence does not require a detector-positive result
constructed_truth.limitations: constructed pilot-only Qin controls are not physical ground truth outside their injected components
